en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Al Dahqan, from dorost Al Wasity, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you eat the cucumbers, so eat it from its lower part, for it is greater in its Blessing’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah al-Dihqan from Durust al- Wasitiy from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When you eat cucumber, eat it from the bottom because it is greater for blessing.”’
